Critical observation about `cg::reduce`:
```cpp
float warp_sum = cg::reduce(warp, thread_sum, cg::plus<float>());
```

The `block.sync()` after ensures all writes complete before reads occur.

The mutant is **unkillable** because the semantic behavior is identical - all writing threads (whether thread 0 or threads 1-31) write the same warp_sum value to the same location.
